key_none: No RAWG key: covers are not shown.
guide:
RAWG is a free video-game database: it provides the pictures of your games.

1. Create a free account on [rawg.io/apidocs](https://rawg.io/apidocs) and copy your key.
2. Open the “Settings” tab of this page and paste it in “RAWG key”.
3. Come back here and click “Test the key”.
key_adopted: Your site's key was picked up automatically: there is nothing for you to redo. To replace it, paste another one in the “Settings” tab.
forgot_key: Done: the picked-up key is forgotten.
test_refused: RAWG refuses this key. Check it on rawg.io/apidocs.
test_unreachable: RAWG cannot be reached from this server. Try again in a moment.
test_no_key: No key yet: paste it in the “Settings” tab first.
test_invalid: This key does not have the right format (letters, digits, dashes, at least 8 characters). Copy it again from rawg.io/apidocs.
todo_intro: When the site is not sure which game matches a title, it lists it here. If it is not the right game, click “Fix”. If it is the right one, click “This one is right”.
todo_intro_nokey: When the site hesitates about the game of a title, it lists it here. Nothing is listed while the RAWG key is missing.
todo_empty: Nothing to check for now: all covers look right.
todo_more: … and {count} older titles. Fix the ones above: the list updates.
which_intro: Pick the game that matches this title. The site will keep your choice.
search_help: If the right game is not in the list, type its real name here (example: Astro's Playroom).
none_help: The site will show no picture for this title.
status_none: RAWG has no game with a picture for this name. Try another name above, or choose “No cover”.
status_no_key: The RAWG key is not set. Paste it in the “Settings” tab.
status_refused: RAWG refuses the key. Check it in the “Settings” tab.
status_unreachable: RAWG is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
status_rate: You are going too fast. Wait a minute, then reload the page.
saved_game: Noted: this cover is saved for this title.
saved_none: Noted: this title will no longer have a cover.
saved_confirm: Noted: the site's choice is kept for this title.
saved_forgot: Done: the site will choose by itself again.
err_title: This title is not valid. It needs 1 to 120 characters, with at least one letter or digit.
err_full: There are already 1000 corrections. Forget a few in the “Saved covers” tab, then try again.
err_candidate: This game is no longer in RAWG's list. Reload the page and pick another one.
err_image: This picture is not accepted. Pick a game from the list.
err_rate: You are going too fast. Wait a minute, then try again.
err_nothing: There is no cover to keep for this title. Pick a game from the list.
err_no_key: The RAWG key is not set. Paste it in the “Settings” tab.
err_refused: RAWG refuses the key. Check it in the “Settings” tab.
err_unreachable: RAWG is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
err_search: This name is too long: 100 characters at most. Try for example Hollow Knight.
err_forget: This cover is no longer saved, or you are going too fast. Reload the page.
saved_intro: The covers the site keeps for your games, including the ones it found by itself. You can view, change or forget them.
find_help: The title, as your pages write it.
err_find: Write the name of a game, for example Hollow Knight.
saved_empty: Nothing saved yet. Look for a game above, or correct a cover to check.
forget_msg: The cover of “{title}” will be forgotten; the site will look again on its own.
forget_gone: This cover is no longer saved. Go back to the list.
last_ok: Last answer from the cover database: {date}.
outage: The cover database is not answering right now. The covers already found stay displayed.
outage_since: Last answer received: {date}. The button below tries again right away.
outage_never: No answer received yet. The button below tries again right away.
outage_saved: The covers in this table stay displayed on the site in the meantime.
